cards.answerEn: Evaluate memory capacity matching the actual bottleneck, such as an applicable memory-optimized instance.
cards.keyPointZh: CPU余量不代表内存足够，选型要增加当前缺的资源，避免购买大量用不到的计算能力。
cards.keyPointEn: CPU headroom does not supply memory. Increase the constrained resource instead of buying unused compute.
cards.watchOutZh: 先确认指标可信、应用是否可横向拆分，不能凭一个瞬时内存峰值永久过配。
cards.watchOutEn: Validate metrics and horizontal scalability; one transient peak does not justify permanent overprovisioning.
mustAnswer: Evaluate more suitable memory capacity
Match the constrained resource rather than spare CPU

cards.topic: ASG limits and policies / ASG上下限与策略
cards.learningGoal: ASG已设最小和最大实例数，流量增长时就会自动按目标CPU扩容吗？
cards.frontZh: ASG已设最小和最大实例数，流量增长时就会自动按目标CPU扩容吗？
cards.frontEn: An ASG has minimum/maximum sizes. Will rising traffic automatically scale toward a CPU target?
cards.answerZh: 不会只因设置上下限就按CPU伸缩；应配置适用的动态策略，例如target tracking。
cards.answerEn: Limits alone do not do that. Configure an applicable dynamic policy such as target tracking.
cards.keyPointZh: 上下限限定允许的容量范围，目标追踪才根据选定负载指标调整desired capacity。
cards.keyPointEn: Limits bound allowed capacity; target tracking changes desired capacity from the selected load metric.
cards.watchOutZh: 指标要能反映工作负载，且仍受容量上下限与启动时间限制。
cards.watchOutEn: Metrics must represent workload, with size limits and startup time still applying.
mustAnswer: Configure target tracking or another applicable dynamic policy
Min/max bounds do not define metric-driven scaling

cards.topic: Preparing capacity in advance / 提前准备容量
cards.learningGoal: 高峰到来前就得准备实例：已知每天固定开场时间，与需要从历史流量预测高峰，扩容怎样安排？
cards.frontZh: 高峰到来前就得准备实例：已知每天固定开场时间，与需要从历史流量预测高峰，扩容怎样安排？
cards.frontEn: Capacity must be ready before peaks. How do a fixed daily opening time and prediction from traffic history change scaling choice?
cards.answerZh: 已知日历和容量用scheduled scaling；按历史规律估计容量可用predictive scaling，并配合实时动态调整。
cards.answerEn: Use scheduled scaling for known times/capacities and predictive scaling for historical patterns, combined with real-time dynamic adjustment.
cards.keyPointZh: 提前准备减少等高负载出现后才启动实例的等待；历史预测和人工给定日历是不同的容量来源。
cards.keyPointEn: Advance preparation avoids waiting to launch after high load arrives. Forecasts and manually supplied schedules are different capacity inputs.
cards.watchOutZh: 临时偏离预测的流量仍需实时策略应对，预测不是保证实际负载完全一致。
cards.watchOutEn: Unexpected traffic still needs real-time policies; forecasts do not guarantee actual demand.
mustAnswer: Known schedule: scheduled scaling
Historical prediction: predictive scaling, with dynamic adjustments

cards.topic: Scaling queue workloads / 队列工作量伸缩
cards.learningGoal: 消费者处理SQS工作，CPU还不高但排队越来越长。只按CPU扩容能准确反映积压吗？
cards.frontZh: 消费者处理SQS工作，CPU还不高但排队越来越长。只按CPU扩容能准确反映积压吗？
cards.frontEn: SQS consumers have low CPU but a growing queue. Does CPU alone accurately measure backlog?
cards.answerZh: 不一定；用每实例积压量或等候时间等适合的工作量指标驱动伸缩。
cards.answerEn: Not necessarily. Scale from workload metrics such as backlog per instance or waiting time.
cards.keyPointZh: 相同队列长度由更多消费者分担时压力不同，每实例积压量把待处理工作与处理容量联系起来。
cards.keyPointEn: The same queue length imposes different pressure with different consumer counts. Per-instance backlog relates work to processing capacity.
cards.watchOutZh: 应按任务平均处理时间设置目标，不能把全部队列长度不加换算地当稳定的每实例压力。
cards.watchOutEn: Set targets using average processing time; raw total queue length is not stable per-instance pressure.
mustAnswer: Use backlog per instance or suitable wait-time metrics
Relate pending work to processing capacity rather than CPU alone

cards.topic: Hibernated warm pools / 休眠预热池
cards.learningGoal: ASG把实例先初始化、放入warm pool候命。扩容时还要直接续用已加载的RAM状态，只用Stopped预热够吗？
cards.frontZh: ASG把实例先初始化、放入warm pool候命。扩容时还要直接续用已加载的RAM状态，只用Stopped预热够吗？
cards.frontEn: An ASG initializes instances in a warm pool and must resume loaded RAM state on scale-out. Is a Stopped pool enough?
cards.answerZh: 不够；可评估支持休眠的Hibernated warm pool，把RAM状态也保存下来。
cards.answerEn: No. Evaluate a supported Hibernated warm pool to retain RAM state too.
cards.keyPointZh: 普通停止主要保留磁盘；休眠把RAM写入EBS，恢复时接续内存和进程状态，减少重新加载这部分准备的等待。
cards.keyPointEn: Ordinary stopping mainly preserves disks; hibernation saves RAM to EBS and resumes memory/process state, reducing reload preparation.
cards.watchOutZh: 预热实例仍有支持条件和费用，不等于任何应用状态都能无限预先准备。
cards.watchOutEn: Warm instances still have support requirements and charges; arbitrary application state cannot be prepared without limits.
mustAnswer: Supported Hibernated warm pool
Hibernation saves RAM to EBS unlike ordinary stopping

cards.topic: Placement latency and isolation / 放置延迟与隔离
cards.learningGoal: 紧耦合计算要降低节点间通信延迟，与独立节点要分散硬件故障风险，placement策略取舍是什么？
cards.frontZh: 紧耦合计算要降低节点间通信延迟，与独立节点要分散硬件故障风险，placement策略取舍是什么？
cards.frontEn: How do placement strategies differ for tightly coupled low-latency compute versus independent nodes needing hardware-failure separation?
cards.answerZh: 通信密集可用cluster placement把节点集中；需要硬件隔离时用适用的spread等分散策略。
cards.answerEn: Use cluster placement for communication-intensive nodes and applicable spread-style strategies for hardware isolation.
cards.keyPointZh: 靠近有利于通信，分散降低共同硬件故障影响，放置位置服务于不同目标。
cards.keyPointEn: Proximity helps communication; dispersion reduces shared hardware-failure impact. Placement serves different objectives.
cards.watchOutZh: 账户不同或tenancy名称不同，不自动证明节点已按要求分散到不同硬件。
cards.watchOutEn: Different accounts or tenancy names do not automatically prove hardware separation.
mustAnswer: Communication: cluster; isolation: applicable spread strategy
Proximity and dispersion address different objectives

cards.topic: HPC communication interfaces / HPC通信接口
cards.learningGoal: 受支持Linux HPC节点频繁交换数据，瓶颈在通信栈，应用已有适用通信库。应评估哪种接口，为什么？
cards.frontZh: 受支持Linux HPC节点频繁交换数据，瓶颈在通信栈，应用已有适用通信库。应评估哪种接口，为什么？
cards.frontEn: Supported Linux HPC nodes exchange data frequently, communication-stack overhead is the bottleneck, and compatible libraries exist. Which interface merits evaluation, and why?
cards.answerZh: 评估Elastic Fabric Adapter（EFA）。
cards.answerEn: Elastic Fabric Adapter (EFA).
cards.keyPointZh: 适用通信软件可通过Libfabric等绕过传统OS内核通信路径，减少开销，适合低延迟紧耦合节点通信。
cards.keyPointEn: Applicable software uses Libfabric and similar paths to bypass traditional OS-kernel communication, reducing tightly coupled low-latency communication overhead.
cards.watchOutZh: 须满足实例、驱动和软件支持；它不替代全球用户到Region的互联网入口加速。
cards.watchOutEn: Instance, driver, and software support are required; EFA does not replace global internet-entry acceleration.
mustAnswer: EFA
Supported libraries reduce kernel-path communication overhead

cards.topic: Instance network bottlenecks / 实例网络瓶颈
cards.learningGoal: EC2网络吞吐或每秒包数成了瓶颈。只多挂几块网卡就一定提高实例总网络上限吗？
cards.frontZh: EC2网络吞吐或每秒包数成了瓶颈。只多挂几块网卡就一定提高实例总网络上限吗？
cards.frontEn: EC2 throughput or packets per second is limiting. Will adding ENIs necessarily raise the instance's total network ceiling?
cards.answerZh: 不一定；应评估实例网络规格及适用的ENA等增强网络能力。
cards.answerEn: No. Evaluate instance network specifications and supported enhanced networking such as ENA.
cards.keyPointZh: 网卡数量与实例可用网络能力不是同一指标，增强网络和合适实例规格才作用于相应数据路径。
cards.keyPointEn: Interface count and instance network capability differ. Enhanced networking and appropriate instance sizing affect the relevant data path.
cards.watchOutZh: 驱动、实例支持和具体网络限额仍须匹配，不能把任意实例加网卡当作无限扩带宽。
cards.watchOutEn: Drivers, instance support, and actual limits apply; extra ENIs are not unlimited bandwidth.
mustAnswer: Evaluate instance specifications and supported ENA
More interfaces alone do not increase every instance's total limit

cards.topic: Routing by outstanding requests / 按未完成请求分流
cards.learningGoal: ALB监控中RequestCount（请求数）和TargetResponseTime（后端响应耗时）升高，部分目标积压。怎样让新请求避开仍有大量未完成工作的目标？
cards.frontZh: ALB监控中RequestCount（请求数）和TargetResponseTime（后端响应耗时）升高，部分目标积压。怎样让新请求避开仍有大量未完成工作的目标？
cards.frontEn: ALB RequestCount and TargetResponseTime rise and some targets accumulate work. How can new requests avoid targets with many unfinished requests?
cards.answerZh: 评估least outstanding requests算法，将新请求导向未完成请求较少的适用目标。
cards.answerEn: Evaluate least outstanding requests routing to eligible targets with fewer unfinished requests.
cards.keyPointZh: 它依据当前未完成工作数分配请求，比只轮流分配更能反映这类忙闲差异；监控指标用于诊断，不是两条CloudWatch阈值直接控制路由。
cards.keyPointEn: It reflects current unfinished work better than simple rotation. Monitoring diagnoses the problem; two CloudWatch thresholds do not directly route requests.
cards.watchOutZh: ActiveConnectionCount量连接而非响应耗时；未完成请求数也不等于CPU使用率。
cards.watchOutEn: ActiveConnectionCount measures connections, not response time; unfinished requests are not CPU usage.
mustAnswer: Least outstanding requests
Routes by remaining work rather than simple rotation

cards.topic: On-premises IP targets / 机房IP目标
cards.learningGoal: 区域负载均衡要把流量送到已通过私网连通的机房服务器。能按AWS实例ID注册这台非EC2服务器吗？
cards.frontZh: 区域负载均衡要把流量送到已通过私网连通的机房服务器。能按AWS实例ID注册这台非EC2服务器吗？
cards.frontEn: A regional load balancer must reach on-premises servers over working private connectivity. Can a non-EC2 server be registered by AWS instance ID?
cards.answerZh: 不能；应使用服务支持的IP目标方式，注册允许范围内的可达目标地址。
cards.answerEn: No. Use supported IP targets with reachable addresses in allowed ranges.
cards.keyPointZh: 实例ID指向相应AWS实例，IP目标把转发目标与EC2身份分开，可接入支持范围内的远端私网服务。
cards.keyPointEn: Instance IDs identify AWS instances. IP targeting decouples destinations from EC2 identity for supported remote private services.
cards.watchOutZh: 仍须满足目标地址、路由和健康检查规则，不意味着任意公网地址都能注册。
cards.watchOutEn: Address, routing, and health-check restrictions remain; arbitrary public addresses are not all valid targets.
mustAnswer: Supported IP target registration
Non-EC2 servers do not have the required AWS instance identity

cards.topic: Weighted DNS releases / DNS权重发布
cards.learningGoal: 新版本只想先接收少量DNS流量，再逐步增加。按比例分流应使用哪类路由？
cards.frontZh: 新版本只想先接收少量DNS流量，再逐步增加。按比例分流应使用哪类路由？
cards.frontEn: A new release should get a small DNS traffic share, then increase gradually. Which routing policy controls proportions?
cards.answerZh: Route 53 weighted routing，给新旧入口设置相应权重。
cards.answerEn: Route 53 weighted routing with appropriate old/new record weights.
cards.keyPointZh: 权重控制DNS选择各记录的相对比例，适合逐步发布；延迟和地理路由按其他条件选择。 Route 53按所设权重随机选择DNS记录；相等权重可用于随机分流。
cards.keyPointEn: Weights set relative DNS-selection probabilities; latency/geographic policies use other criteria. Selection is random by configured weights, including equal-weight random distribution.
cards.watchOutZh: DNS缓存等会影响实际终端请求比例，不保证每十个HTTP请求严格按同样比例分配。
cards.watchOutEn: Caching affects actual request proportions; HTTP requests are not guaranteed to divide exactly per ten requests.
mustAnswer: Weighted routing
Relative record weights support gradual DNS traffic shifts

cards.topic: Multivalue DNS answers / DNS多值回答
cards.learningGoal: DNS希望一次回答多个健康服务地址，而不是始终只给一个地址。可以考虑什么路由，它等同真正负载均衡器吗？
cards.frontZh: DNS希望一次回答多个健康服务地址，而不是始终只给一个地址。可以考虑什么路由，它等同真正负载均衡器吗？
cards.frontEn: DNS should return several healthy service addresses per answer. Which routing fits, and is it a real load balancer?
cards.answerZh: 可考虑Route 53 multivalue answer；它不等同连接层或HTTP负载均衡器。
cards.answerEn: Consider Route 53 multivalue answer; it is not a connection/HTTP load balancer.
cards.keyPointZh: Route 53可随机返回最多8个经过适用健康筛选的资源地址，客户端再选择连接目标；返回多地址不等于DNS代理后续业务连接。
cards.keyPointEn: It can randomly return up to eight appropriately health-filtered addresses; clients choose destinations. Multiple answers do not proxy subsequent connections.
cards.watchOutZh: 它不会代理每条连接、执行HTTP路由或让已有连接自动迁移到健康实例。
cards.watchOutEn: It does not proxy connections, apply HTTP routing, or migrate established connections automatically.
mustAnswer: Multivalue answer
Returns healthy address choices rather than proxying business connections

cards.topic: Authoritative DNS delegation / 权威DNS委派
cards.learningGoal: 公网域名的权威DNS要迁到Route 53。只让Resolver把查询转发给旧DNS，就完成权威托管迁移了吗？
cards.frontZh: 公网域名的权威DNS要迁到Route 53。只让Resolver把查询转发给旧DNS，就完成权威托管迁移了吗？
cards.frontEn: A public domain's authoritative DNS moves to Route 53. Does forwarding Resolver queries to the old DNS complete migration?
cards.answerZh: 没有；应建立public hosted zone和对应记录，并把域名的权威委派指向Route 53提供的名称服务器。
cards.answerEn: No. Create a public hosted zone/records and delegate the domain to Route 53's supplied name servers.
cards.keyPointZh: 权威委派决定全球解析链最终向谁取记录；转发查询只是换了解析路径，权威记录仍可能在旧系统。
cards.keyPointEn: Delegation determines the final authoritative source in global resolution. Forwarding only changes the query path and may leave authority at the old system.
cards.watchOutZh: 私有托管区域不能直接承担任意互联网用户的公网权威解析。
cards.watchOutEn: Private hosted zones do not directly provide public authority for arbitrary internet users.
mustAnswer: Public hosted zone and records plus authoritative delegation
Forwarding queries does not move authoritative ownership

cards.topic: Cache keys and content variants / 缓存键与内容变体
cards.learningGoal: 同一URL按语言返回不同内容。CloudFront只转发语言请求头，但缓存键不区分语言，会有什么问题？
cards.frontZh: 同一URL按语言返回不同内容。CloudFront只转发语言请求头，但缓存键不区分语言，会有什么问题？
cards.frontEn: One URL returns different languages. CloudFront forwards the language header but omits it from the cache key. What goes wrong?
cards.answerZh: 不同语言可能共用同一缓存响应；应把真正影响内容版本的值纳入适用缓存键。
cards.answerEn: Languages may share one cached response. Include values actually determining content versions in the applicable cache key.
cards.keyPointZh: 源站收到哪些字段与缓存把哪些请求视作同一个对象，是两种配置；键必须区分实际内容变体。
cards.keyPointEn: Origin forwarding and which requests cache treats as identical are separate configurations. Keys must distinguish actual variants.
cards.watchOutZh: CachingOptimized的缓存键不包含Authorization或查询参数，不能仅因转发了这些字段就当成已隔离内容；也别把所有无关字段都加入键而降低复用率。
cards.watchOutEn: CachingOptimized excludes Authorization and query parameters. Forwarding them alone does not isolate content; irrelevant key fields also reduce reuse.
mustAnswer: Different languages may reuse the same cached response
Forwarding a header does not make the cache key distinguish language variants

cards.topic: Invalidation and revalidation / 失效与持续重验证
cards.learningGoal: S3源端已更新，CloudFront还可能返回旧响应。单次清除旧副本，与每次复用前验证新鲜度，分别用什么？
cards.frontZh: S3源端已更新，CloudFront还可能返回旧响应。单次清除旧副本，与每次复用前验证新鲜度，分别用什么？
cards.frontEn: S3 changed but CloudFront may serve old data. What handles one-time removal versus freshness checks before each reuse?
cards.answerZh: 单次更新可用invalidation使旧对象失效；持续重验证用符合要求的no-cache或零有效期策略。
cards.answerEn: Use invalidation for a one-time update; use compliant no-cache or zero-effective-lifetime policies for continuous revalidation.
cards.keyPointZh: 源端强一致不清除边缘副本。默认TTL用于源未给明确缓存时长时；源给max-age等时须连同缓存策略最小/最大TTL判断。发布时失效让下次回源，重验证则检查旧响应能否继续用。
cards.keyPointEn: Origin strong consistency does not clear edges. Default TTL applies without explicit origin lifetime; max-age must be evaluated with policy min/max TTL. Invalidation forces later origin retrieval; revalidation checks whether old responses remain usable.
cards.watchOutZh: 最小TTL大于0可能覆盖源站no-cache/no-store要求；例如CachingOptimized最小TTL是1秒。实际缓存策略必须符合所需新鲜度。
cards.watchOutEn: A positive minimum TTL can override no-cache/no-store; CachingOptimized's minimum is one second. Match policy to required freshness.
mustAnswer: One-time: invalidation
Before each reuse: compatible revalidation/zero-lifetime policy

cards.topic: CloudFront multi-origin routing / CloudFront多源路由
cards.learningGoal: 静态文件在S3，动态接口在ALB，希望用户用同一个CloudFront域名。必须把两类内容搬到同一个源站吗？
cards.frontZh: 静态文件在S3，动态接口在ALB，希望用户用同一个CloudFront域名。必须把两类内容搬到同一个源站吗？
cards.frontEn: S3 static files and an ALB dynamic API need one CloudFront domain. Must both move to one origin?
cards.answerZh: 不必；为分发配置多个origin，并用路径cache behavior把请求送到相应源站。
cards.answerEn: No. Configure multiple origins and path cache behaviors routing requests to each.
cards.keyPointZh: 分发入口统一，后端按请求路径选择数据或计算源，静态和动态服务可保留各自职责。
cards.keyPointEn: A unified entry selects storage/compute origins by path while preserving separate backend responsibilities.
cards.watchOutZh: 动态行为的缓存和转发规则要按业务配置，多个origin本身不会保证请求正确分流。
cards.watchOutEn: Configure dynamic caching/forwarding appropriately; multiple origins alone do not guarantee correct routing.
mustAnswer: Multiple origins with path behaviors
Unified entry does not require one backend origin

cards.topic: Lambda execution compatibility / Lambda运行环境兼容
cards.learningGoal: 同样只跑几分钟：Python函数需要1GB内存，另一项是现成Windows容器。两者都能直接用标准Lambda吗？
cards.frontZh: 同样只跑几分钟：Python函数需要1GB内存，另一项是现成Windows容器。两者都能直接用标准Lambda吗？
cards.frontEn: Both tasks run minutes: a Python function needs 1 GB and another is an existing Windows container. Can both use standard Lambda?
cards.answerZh: Python函数可用受支持的Python运行时并配置1GB内存；Windows容器不适合标准Lambda，可在支持该Windows版本的ECS/Fargate或Batch Windows环境运行。
cards.answerEn: Use a supported Python runtime with 1 GB for the function. Standard Lambda does not fit Windows containers; use a Windows-version-compatible ECS/Fargate or Batch environment.
cards.keyPointZh: 标准Lambda提供受支持的Linux函数执行环境，内存可以配置；任务短不等于能把另一种操作系统的现成容器直接运行进去。
cards.keyPointEn: Standard Lambda provides supported Linux function environments with configurable memory. Short duration does not make a different-OS container compatible.
cards.watchOutZh: 标准Lambda调用通常受900秒上限；特殊执行产品模式另按其限制判断，不能把一种模式的规则推给全部计算。
cards.watchOutEn: Standard invocation is generally limited to 900 seconds. Specialized execution-product modes have their own limits, not universally identical rules.
mustAnswer: Supported Python Lambda for the first; compatible Windows environment for the second
Runtime/OS compatibility matters beyond short duration

cards.topic: Concurrency limits and prewarming / 并发额度与预热
cards.learningGoal: Lambda既有“限制最多同时运行多少”，又有“提前准备执行环境减少冷启动”的需求。reserved和provisioned concurrency各解决什么？
cards.frontZh: Lambda既有“限制最多同时运行多少”，又有“提前准备执行环境减少冷启动”的需求。reserved和provisioned concurrency各解决什么？
cards.frontEn: Lambda must limit simultaneous executions and also preprepare environments to reduce cold starts. What do reserved and provisioned concurrency do?
cards.answerZh: reserved concurrency预留并限制并发额度；provisioned concurrency预先初始化相应执行环境。
cards.answerEn: Reserved concurrency reserves and caps concurrency; provisioned concurrency preinitializes execution environments.
cards.keyPointZh: 允许同时执行的名额，与环境是否已准备好，是两个不同维度。
cards.keyPointEn: Execution slots and whether environments are ready are separate dimensions.
cards.watchOutZh: 只设置reserved concurrency不会自动把所有环境预热。
cards.watchOutEn: Reserved concurrency alone does not prewarm every environment.
mustAnswer: Reserved: reserved/capped execution slots
Provisioned: initialized environments

cards.topic: Java cold-start snapshots / Java冷启动快照
cards.learningGoal: Java 11 Lambda初始化慢，希望减少扩容冷启动，没有严格的预热环境保证要求。怎样改善，为什么先比较SnapStart？
cards.frontZh: Java 11 Lambda初始化慢，希望减少扩容冷启动，没有严格的预热环境保证要求。怎样改善，为什么先比较SnapStart？
cards.frontEn: Java 11 Lambda initializes slowly and needs fewer scaling cold starts, without a strict prewarmed-environment guarantee. How can it improve, and why compare SnapStart first?
cards.answerZh: 发布适用版本时保存初始化状态快照，新环境可从快照恢复。
cards.answerEn: Save an initialization-state snapshot when publishing an applicable version; new environments restore from it.
cards.keyPointZh: 复用初始化状态，避免新环境重复昂贵初始化；Java受管运行时的SnapStart无额外功能费用，适合先比较它，而不是持续付费维持provisioned concurrency。
cards.keyPointEn: Reusing initialization avoids repeating expensive setup. Managed Java runtime SnapStart has no additional feature charge, making it worth comparing before continuously paid provisioned concurrency.
cards.watchOutZh: 先核对功能兼容；快照不等于始终预热的环境，需要每环境唯一的值不能直接固化在共享快照里。
cards.watchOutEn: Check compatibility. Snapshots are not always-prewarmed environments; values requiring per-environment uniqueness cannot simply be frozen into a shared snapshot.
mustAnswer: Applicable SnapStart initialization snapshot/restore
Reuses costly initialization without managed-Java SnapStart feature charges

cards.topic: ECS tasks and hosting capacity / ECS任务与承载容量
cards.learningGoal: ECS要随业务负载自动增加任务副本；如果用EC2承载，新任务却放不下。服务伸缩和底层容量伸缩各管什么？
cards.frontZh: ECS要随业务负载自动增加任务副本；如果用EC2承载，新任务却放不下。服务伸缩和底层容量伸缩各管什么？
cards.frontEn: ECS needs more tasks with business load, but EC2 hosts cannot fit them. What do service and underlying-capacity scaling each manage?
cards.answerZh: Service Auto Scaling按CloudWatch指标增减服务任务数；EC2承载时，还要用适用容量提供者或实例伸缩补足底层资源。
cards.answerEn: Service Auto Scaling changes service task count using CloudWatch metrics. On EC2, applicable capacity providers or instance scaling must supply underlying resources too.
cards.keyPointZh: 任务数是要运行多少份应用，实例容量是有没有CPU和内存放下它们；增加任务需求不会自动创造主机容量。
cards.keyPointEn: Task count is desired application copies; instance capacity supplies CPU/memory to fit them. More task demand does not create hosts automatically.
cards.watchOutZh: Fargate与自管EC2的底层管理不同，不把同一ASG步骤套到所有ECS部署。
cards.watchOutEn: Fargate and self-managed EC2 differ; do not apply the same ASG steps to every deployment.
mustAnswer: Service scaling changes task count
EC2 hosting capacity separately needs scaling to place those tasks

cards.topic: Pod and node scaling / Pod与节点扩容
cards.learningGoal: EKS已由HPA增加Pod副本，但Pod因节点资源不足一直Pending。继续只提高Pod副本数有用吗？
cards.frontZh: EKS已由HPA增加Pod副本，但Pod因节点资源不足一直Pending。继续只提高Pod副本数有用吗？
cards.frontEn: HPA added EKS Pods but insufficient node resources leave them Pending. Is increasing replicas alone enough?
cards.answerZh: 不够；还要用适用的节点自动伸缩能力增加可调度节点，如Karpenter或Cluster Autoscaler。
cards.answerEn: No. Add schedulable nodes through applicable node autoscaling such as Karpenter or Cluster Autoscaler.
cards.keyPointZh: HPA调整工作负载副本，节点伸缩补充承载资源，两个层次须配合。
cards.keyPointEn: HPA changes workload copies; node scaling supplies their hosting resources. Both layers must cooperate.
cards.watchOutZh: Pending也可能由其他调度条件造成，先确认确实是可解决的节点容量不足。
cards.watchOutEn: Pending has other causes too; confirm capacity shortage that more nodes can solve.
mustAnswer: Applicable node autoscaling
HPA increases Pods, not the node capacity they require

cards.topic: Orchestrator compatibility and cost / 编排兼容与费用
cards.learningGoal: 必须保留Kubernetes部署对象与API，或没有这项要求、只想少维护主机并降低编排成本，EKS和ECS怎样选？
cards.frontZh: 必须保留Kubernetes部署对象与API，或没有这项要求、只想少维护主机并降低编排成本，EKS和ECS怎样选？
cards.frontEn: How should EKS/ECS differ when Kubernetes deployment objects/APIs must stay versus no such requirement and lower host/orchestration administration cost is desired?
cards.answerZh: 保留Kubernetes方式优先评估EKS；没有该要求时可评估ECS配Fargate。
cards.answerEn: Evaluate EKS for Kubernetes compatibility; otherwise evaluate ECS with Fargate.
cards.keyPointZh: 镜像相似不代表编排接口相同。EKS提供Kubernetes控制面并有集群费用；ECS编排无额外费用，Fargate在两者中都可减少主机维护。
cards.keyPointEn: Similar images do not imply identical orchestration APIs. EKS offers Kubernetes control planes with cluster charges; ECS orchestration has no additional fee. Fargate reduces host maintenance for either.
cards.watchOutZh: 仍要支付底层计算等资源费用；EKS托管控制面也不等于应用全部免维护。
cards.watchOutEn: Underlying compute still costs money; managed EKS does not remove all application maintenance.
mustAnswer: Required Kubernetes interface: EKS
Otherwise ECS/Fargate may avoid EKS orchestration charges while reducing host management

cards.topic: On-premises ECS execution / 本地ECS运行
cards.learningGoal: 容器必须继续在机房运行，但希望由ECS管理。把管理接到AWS，会自动把计算也迁到Fargate吗？
cards.frontZh: 容器必须继续在机房运行，但希望由ECS管理。把管理接到AWS，会自动把计算也迁到Fargate吗？
cards.frontEn: Containers must remain on premises while ECS manages them. Does cloud management automatically move computation to Fargate?
cards.answerZh: 不会；可评估ECS Anywhere把适用外部实例纳入管理，工作负载仍在本地主机执行。
cards.answerEn: No. Evaluate ECS Anywhere for eligible external instances while workloads execute on local hosts.
cards.keyPointZh: 管理控制面所在位置与实际运行容器的位置可以分开，连接云端管理不等于搬走本地计算。
cards.keyPointEn: Management control-plane location and actual container execution location can differ. Cloud management does not imply moving local compute.
cards.watchOutZh: 外部实例、联网和功能支持仍须满足，不能把云端Fargate承载能力当作机房本地运行。
cards.watchOutEn: External-instance, connectivity, and feature requirements apply; cloud Fargate is not on-premises hosting.
mustAnswer: ECS Anywhere for supported external hosts
Management can be in AWS while computation stays local

cards.topic: Collecting memory metrics / 采集内存指标
cards.learningGoal: EC2要按内存压力扩容，但默认CloudWatch监控里只有现成CPU等指标。提高监控展示刷新速度就会出现内存指标吗？
cards.frontZh: EC2要按内存压力扩容，但默认CloudWatch监控里只有现成CPU等指标。提高监控展示刷新速度就会出现内存指标吗？
cards.frontEn: EC2 must scale by memory pressure but default CloudWatch has CPU and other existing metrics. Does faster dashboard refresh produce memory metrics?
cards.answerZh: 不会；须用CloudWatch Agent或其他适用方式采集并发布所需自定义内存指标。
cards.answerEn: No. Collect/publish the required custom memory metrics with CloudWatch Agent or another applicable method.
cards.keyPointZh: 没有采集的数据，不能靠更频繁展示生成；指标来源和展示间隔是不同问题。
cards.keyPointEn: More frequent display cannot create uncollected data. Metric sources and display intervals are separate.
cards.watchOutZh: 先确认指标实际到达且维度正确，再让伸缩策略使用它。
cards.watchOutEn: Verify arrival and dimensions before scaling from the metric.
mustAnswer: Collect/publish custom memory metrics
Dashboard refresh cannot generate missing observations

cards.topic: Request tracing / 请求链路追踪
cards.learningGoal: 一次用户请求经过多个微服务，整体变慢，却不知道时间耗在哪个调用环节。只看AWS API审计够吗？
cards.frontZh: 一次用户请求经过多个微服务，整体变慢，却不知道时间耗在哪个调用环节。只看AWS API审计够吗？
cards.frontEn: One user request spans microservices and is slow, but the slow hop is unknown. Is AWS API auditing enough?
cards.answerZh: 不够；使用适用的分布式追踪，如X-Ray/OpenTelemetry相关接入。
cards.answerEn: No. Use applicable distributed tracing, such as X-Ray/OpenTelemetry integration.
cards.keyPointZh: 追踪把同一请求的不同调用片段关联起来，显示各环节耗时；API审计主要回答谁操作了AWS资源。
cards.keyPointEn: Traces correlate calls within one request and expose hop durations. API auditing mainly identifies who operated AWS resources.
cards.watchOutZh: 服务须实际接入并传递关联信息，不是打开一个仪表板就自动得到完整业务链路。
cards.watchOutEn: Services must propagate correlation and be instrumented; opening a dashboard does not create complete traces.
mustAnswer: Distributed tracing
Correlated request segments locate per-hop latency

cards.topic: Container runtime metrics / 容器运行指标
cards.learningGoal: 要看ECS或EKS容器的CPU、内存与日志，CloudTrail记录AWS API操作就够吗？
cards.frontZh: 要看ECS或EKS容器的CPU、内存与日志，CloudTrail记录AWS API操作就够吗？
cards.frontEn: Does CloudTrail API auditing supply ECS/EKS CPU, memory, and logs?
cards.answerZh: 不够；应启用适用的Container Insights等工作负载指标和日志采集。
cards.answerEn: No. Enable applicable workload metric/log collection such as Container Insights.
cards.keyPointZh: 容器运行时表现与谁调用AWS管理API是不同信息，应用性能必须来自对应运行数据。
cards.keyPointEn: Container runtime behavior differs from who invoked management APIs; performance needs corresponding runtime data.
cards.watchOutZh: 监控要实际配置采集，不能因为集群已创建就假定全部容器日志自动可查。
cards.watchOutEn: Collection must actually be configured; creating a cluster does not automatically expose every container log.
mustAnswer: Container Insights or applicable workload collection
Runtime metrics/logs are different from API audit events

cards.topic: Composite alarm conditions / 组合告警条件
cards.learningGoal: 只有CPU高并且另一个健康告警也触发时，才通知值班。两个独立alarm各自发邮件能表达这个条件吗？
cards.frontZh: 只有CPU高并且另一个健康告警也触发时，才通知值班。两个独立alarm各自发邮件能表达这个条件吗？
cards.frontEn: Notify on-call only when both high CPU and another health alarm occur. Can two independent email alarms directly express that?
cards.answerZh: 不能直接表达共同条件；可用composite alarm组合已有alarm状态。
cards.answerEn: No. Use a composite alarm combining existing alarm states.
cards.keyPointZh: 组合告警用AND、OR等逻辑判断多个告警状态，在满足整体条件时才采取相应通知。
cards.keyPointEn: AND/OR logic evaluates multiple alarm states and notifies when the combined condition holds.
cards.watchOutZh: 组合的是告警状态，底层各指标仍须正确采集并设置。
cards.watchOutEn: Underlying metric collection and alarms must still be configured correctly.
mustAnswer: Composite alarm with AND
Combines alarm states instead of notifying independently

cards.topic: Sampling and display resolution / 采样与展示粒度
cards.learningGoal: EC2性能分析要达到1分钟粒度，普通指标每5分钟一个点。每秒刷新仪表板能补齐吗，应改哪里？
cards.frontZh: EC2性能分析要达到1分钟粒度，普通指标每5分钟一个点。每秒刷新仪表板能补齐吗，应改哪里？
cards.frontEn: EC2 analysis needs one-minute data, but ordinary metrics have five-minute points. Does refreshing every second fix it, and what should change?
cards.answerZh: 不能靠刷新补齐；对适用EC2标准指标启用详细监控，可得到1分钟粒度。若需秒级，则按支持范围采集高分辨率自定义指标。
cards.answerEn: No. Enable detailed monitoring for applicable EC2 standard metrics to obtain one-minute data. For second-level needs, collect supported high-resolution custom metrics.
cards.keyPointZh: 采样与存储粒度决定有没有记录变化，展示只是重读已有点；基本监控常见5分钟，详细监控1分钟，高分辨率自定义指标可到1秒。
cards.keyPointEn: Sampling/storage resolution determines whether changes were recorded. Display only rereads points: basic commonly five minutes, detailed one minute, high-resolution custom as fine as one second.
cards.watchOutZh: 部分状态检查指标本来就是1分钟；重复上传低频值也不会产生真实高频观测。
cards.watchOutEn: Some status checks already have one-minute data. Reuploading low-frequency values does not create real high-frequency observations.
mustAnswer: Detailed monitoring for applicable one-minute EC2 metrics
Change collection resolution, not dashboard refresh

cards.topic: Batch compute-environment limits / Batch计算环境上限
cards.learningGoal: 批任务要托管排队调度，何时能用AWS Batch配Fargate，何时应改用EC2计算环境？例如单作业实际需要64vCPU和512GiB。
cards.frontZh: 批任务要托管排队调度，何时能用AWS Batch配Fargate，何时应改用EC2计算环境？例如单作业实际需要64vCPU和512GiB。
cards.frontEn: When can managed Batch scheduling use Fargate, and when EC2? A single job actually needs 64 vCPUs and 512 GiB.
cards.answerZh: 符合Fargate作业范围时可用Batch+Fargate免维护主机；64vCPU/512GiB超当前单作业范围，应让Batch在足够规格的EC2计算环境调度。
cards.answerEn: Use Batch/Fargate within its supported job scope for no host maintenance. The 64-vCPU/512-GiB job exceeds it and needs sufficiently sized Batch EC2 compute.
cards.keyPointZh: Batch负责排队与调度，计算环境提供实际资源；当前Fargate作业支持的最大档为32vCPU/244GiB，托管调度不会解除执行环境上限。
cards.keyPointEn: Batch queues/schedules while compute environments provide resources. Fargate's current maximum job size is 32 vCPUs/244 GiB; managed scheduling does not remove that ceiling.
cards.watchOutZh: 原服务器的配置不等于作业实际占用；仍要确认操作系统、资源组合和运行特性适用。
cards.watchOutEn: Source-server size is not actual job usage; verify OS, resource combinations, and execution features.
mustAnswer: Fargate for supported jobs; EC2 for the stated oversized job
Scheduler does not override compute resource limits

cards.topic: Aurora shared-storage failover / Aurora共享存储接管
cards.learningGoal: Aurora的writer（写实例）、reader（读实例）各自保存独立的整份数据库吗？reader为什么也能用于故障接管？
cards.frontZh: Aurora的writer（写实例）、reader（读实例）各自保存独立的整份数据库吗？reader为什么也能用于故障接管？
cards.frontEn: Do Aurora writer and readers each store a separate complete database? Why can a reader take over?
cards.answerZh: 它们共用区域集群存储；reader平时分担读查询，writer故障时可由适用reader提升接管。
cards.answerEn: They share regional cluster storage. Readers serve reads and an eligible reader can be promoted after writer failure.
cards.keyPointZh: 存储层跨AZ保护同一份集群数据；区域reader复制延迟通常低于100毫秒，适合低延迟扩读。
cards.keyPointEn: Storage protects the shared cluster data across AZs. Regional-reader lag is typically under 100 milliseconds, supporting low-latency read scaling.
cards.watchOutZh: 高写入负载仍可能加剧复制延迟；通常值不是所有读取都最新的保证。
cards.watchOutEn: Heavy writes can increase lag; typical latency does not guarantee every read is current.
mustAnswer: Shared regional cluster storage
Eligible readers can be promoted while normally serving reads

cards.topic: Lambda temporary space / Lambda临时空间
cards.learningGoal: Lambda处理文件时需2GB本地临时工作空间，内存和运行时间均适合。默认512MB不够，必须换EC2吗？
cards.frontZh: Lambda处理文件时需2GB本地临时工作空间，内存和运行时间均适合。默认512MB不够，必须换EC2吗？
cards.frontEn: Lambda needs 2 GB local temporary file workspace; memory/duration fit. With default 512 MB insufficient, must it move to EC2?
cards.answerZh: 不必；可把Lambda的/tmp临时存储配置到2GB。
cards.answerEn: No. Configure Lambda /tmp storage to 2 GB.
cards.keyPointZh: /tmp为每个执行环境提供可配置的临时磁盘，范围512至10240MB；增加工作空间不要求把内存也增加到相同大小。
cards.keyPointEn: Each execution environment has configurable temporary disk from 512 to 10,240 MB, independent of matching memory size.
cards.watchOutZh: 它不是跨执行环境共享或长期保留的数据盘；结果应写回S3等持久存储。
cards.watchOutEn: It is not shared across environments or a durable disk; save results to persistent storage such as S3.
mustAnswer: Increase /tmp to 2 GB
Temporary disk is independently configurable from memory

cards.topic: Viewing external clusters / 外部集群集中查看
cards.learningGoal: 已有EKS和机房Kubernetes集群，要从EKS控制台集中查看集群与工作负载，保留机房集群现有管理方式。用什么？
cards.frontZh: 已有EKS和机房Kubernetes集群，要从EKS控制台集中查看集群与工作负载，保留机房集群现有管理方式。用什么？
cards.frontEn: Existing EKS and on-premises Kubernetes clusters need centralized cluster/workload views in EKS while retaining local cluster management. What fits?
cards.answerZh: 用EKS Connector注册并连接符合要求的外部Kubernetes集群。
cards.answerEn: Register/connect eligible external Kubernetes through EKS Connector.
cards.keyPointZh: Connector把集群状态、配置和工作负载呈现在EKS控制台，统一查看不要求先把现有集群迁入EKS。
cards.keyPointEn: It displays cluster state, configuration, and workloads in EKS without first migrating the cluster into EKS.
cards.watchOutZh: 连接后可查看，不能因此通过EKS接管外部集群的管理。
cards.watchOutEn: Connector enables viewing, not EKS takeover of external-cluster management.
mustAnswer: EKS Connector
Central viewing retains existing external-cluster management

cards.topic: Block-storage I/O patterns / 块存储I/O模式
cards.learningGoal: EBS存放频繁随机小块读写的数据库，与连续扫描大文件，这两种负载怎样选择SSD和HDD卷？
cards.frontZh: EBS存放频繁随机小块读写的数据库，与连续扫描大文件，这两种负载怎样选择SSD和HDD卷？
cards.frontEn: How do SSD and HDD EBS choices differ for frequent small random database I/O versus sequential large-file scans?
cards.answerZh: 随机小I/O、看重IOPS和低延迟时考虑gp3或io系列SSD；连续大块吞吐工作负载才比较st1/sc1等HDD。
cards.answerEn: Consider gp3/io-series SSD for random small I/O, IOPS, and latency. Compare st1/sc1 HDD for sequential large-block throughput.
cards.keyPointZh: SSD适合快速完成大量分散的小操作；HDD侧重连续读取/写入的吞吐量。存储容量同样足够，不代表两类卷能提供相同随机访问性能。
cards.keyPointEn: SSD handles many scattered small operations quickly; HDD emphasizes sequential throughput. Equal capacity does not imply equal random-access performance.
cards.watchOutZh: gp3是否足够仍取决于所需IOPS、吞吐和实例能力，不能把所有数据库都直接判给最贵io2。
cards.watchOutEn: gp3 suitability still depends on IOPS, throughput, and instance capacity; not every database needs the most expensive io2.
mustAnswer: Random small I/O: suitable SSD
Sequential large throughput: compare HDD

cards.topic: Compute commitment scope / 计算承诺覆盖范围
cards.learningGoal: 稳定计算同时使用EC2、Lambda、Fargate，EC2型号还可能变化；另有SageMaker用量。怎样用尽量少的计划类型覆盖？
cards.frontZh: 稳定计算同时使用EC2、Lambda、Fargate，EC2型号还可能变化；另有SageMaker用量。怎样用尽量少的计划类型覆盖？
cards.frontEn: Stable compute spans EC2, Lambda, and Fargate with changing EC2 types, plus SageMaker usage. How can few plan types cover it?
cards.answerZh: EC2、Lambda、Fargate用Compute Savings Plans；SageMaker用其自己的Savings Plans。
cards.answerEn: Use Compute Savings Plans for EC2/Lambda/Fargate and separate SageMaker Savings Plans for SageMaker.
cards.keyPointZh: Compute SP按适用计算用量承诺提供灵活折扣，不绑单一EC2实例族；服务范围仍有限，SageMaker不自动算入Compute SP。
cards.keyPointEn: Compute plans discount eligible committed compute flexibly without one EC2 family, but service coverage remains limited; SageMaker is not included automatically.
cards.watchOutZh: Compute SP也不覆盖RDS实例费用；承诺前核对真实稳定用量。
cards.watchOutEn: Compute plans also exclude RDS instance charges. Verify stable usage before committing.
mustAnswer: Compute SP for EC2/Lambda/Fargate
SageMaker's separate SP

cards.topic: Infrequent multi-AZ retrieval / 低频多AZ取回
cards.learningGoal: 低频S3文件仍需多AZ保存。必须立即读取，与允许先恢复后读取，两种条件怎样改变存储层选择？
cards.frontZh: 低频S3文件仍需多AZ保存。必须立即读取，与允许先恢复后读取，两种条件怎样改变存储层选择？
cards.frontEn: Infrequent S3 files need multi-AZ storage. How does immediate access versus waiting for restore change storage-class choice?
cards.answerZh: 立即读取可选Standard-IA或Glacier Instant Retrieval等适用即时层；能等待恢复时，才考虑Glacier Flexible Retrieval或Deep Archive，并按阶段用Lifecycle转换。
cards.answerEn: Immediate access can use applicable instant tiers such as Standard-IA or Glacier Instant Retrieval. With restore delay acceptable, consider Glacier Flexible Retrieval/Deep Archive and lifecycle transitions.
cards.keyPointZh: 先满足取回等待与多AZ要求，再比总费用。Deep Archive以更长等待换最低的归档存储单价，适合多年极少读取；Glacier Instant Retrieval仍可即时读，适合长保留且极少读取。
cards.keyPointEn: Satisfy retrieval delay and multi-AZ needs before total cost. Deep Archive exchanges longer waits for the lowest archive storage rate, fitting rare multi-year access; Glacier Instant Retrieval retains immediate access for rare long-retained data.
cards.watchOutZh: One Zone-IA只有单AZ；低单价仍要计取回费、最低保留期和对象开销，不能直接等同最低总账单。
cards.watchOutEn: One Zone-IA is single-AZ. Retrieval charges, minimum duration, and object overhead mean lowest unit rate is not necessarily the lowest bill.
mustAnswer: Immediate: applicable instant class
Restore delay allowed: suitable archival class, while preserving multi-AZ needs

cards.topic: Budget alerts and restrictions / 预算通知与限制
cards.learningGoal: 账户达到预算阈值后，既要通知负责人，又要自动禁止继续创建资源。只设预算告警够吗，为什么？
cards.frontZh: 账户达到预算阈值后，既要通知负责人，又要自动禁止继续创建资源。只设预算告警够吗，为什么？
cards.frontEn: After a budget threshold, notify the owner and automatically prohibit new resources. Is an alert alone enough, and why?
cards.answerZh: 不够；配置AWS Budgets action，由有权限的服务角色应用拒绝新建资源的IAM策略或SCP，并设置通知。
cards.answerEn: No. Configure an AWS Budgets action with an authorized service role applying a denying IAM policy or SCP, plus notifications.
cards.keyPointZh: 告警负责告知，budget action才执行权限限制；服务角色使Budgets有权代为附加策略。
cards.keyPointEn: Alerts inform; budget actions enforce permission restrictions. The service role authorizes Budgets to attach policies.
cards.watchOutZh: 费用数据和动作有更新延迟，已有资源也可能继续计费，不能当作绝对费用硬上限。
cards.watchOutEn: Cost/action updates lag and existing resources may keep charging; this is not an absolute spending cap.
mustAnswer: Budget action applying appropriate deny policy/SCP through a service role
Alerts notify; actions execute restrictions

cards.topic: Sharing commitment discounts / 共享承诺折扣
cards.learningGoal: 多个原先独立计费的账户要共用已购买但用不完的Savings Plans折扣，怎样组织并开启共享，为什么？
cards.frontZh: 多个原先独立计费的账户要共用已购买但用不完的Savings Plans折扣，怎样组织并开启共享，为什么？
cards.frontEn: Previously separately billed accounts need unused purchased Savings Plans discounts shared. How should accounts and sharing be organized, and why?
cards.answerZh: 把相关账户纳入同一Organizations合并计费组织，由管理账户在Billing preferences启用相应账户的折扣共享。
cards.answerEn: Join the same Organizations consolidated-billing organization and enable applicable account discount sharing in the management account's Billing preferences.
cards.keyPointZh: 共享的是承诺折扣在符合条件用量上的抵扣，不是通过RAM把一台计算资源或一份计划迁给别的账户。
cards.keyPointEn: Sharing applies commitment discounts to eligible usage; RAM does not transfer a compute resource or plan to another account.
mustAnswer: Common consolidated-billing organization and Billing discount sharing
Shares eligible discount application rather than resources through RAM

cards.topic: CloudFront transfer charges / CloudFront传出计费
cards.learningGoal: S3大文件要交给北美和欧洲用户。改由CloudFront分发，为什么可能降低传出费？这等于用户下载全部免费吗？
cards.frontZh: S3大文件要交给北美和欧洲用户。改由CloudFront分发，为什么可能降低传出费？这等于用户下载全部免费吗？
cards.frontEn: Why can CloudFront lower S3 large-file egress costs to North American/European users? Does that make downloads entirely free?
cards.answerZh: S3到CloudFront的AWS回源免数据传出费；用户下载改按所选CloudFront方案核算。已核的北美、欧洲常见付费档，边缘传出单价可低于us-east-1的S3直出，不能把整个分发当免费。
cards.answerEn: AWS S3-to-CloudFront origin transfer has no data-transfer-out charge; viewer downloads follow the selected CloudFront plan. Verified common paid North America/Europe tiers can have lower edge rates than direct us-east-1 S3 egress, but distribution is not free.
cards.keyPointZh: 回源与边缘到用户是两段收费范围；比较的是实际流量档和边缘目的地费率。CloudFront还可从附近缓存交付，延续CA13已教的性能收益。
cards.keyPointEn: Origin-to-edge and edge-to-viewer are separate charging segments. Compare actual tiers/destination rates; nearby caching also retains CA13's performance benefit.
cards.watchOutZh: CloudFront有按用量和flat-rate等方案；应按实际方案、流量及请求核算，免回源不代表免全部费用。
cards.watchOutEn: Compare usage-based or flat-rate plans with actual traffic and requests. Free origin transfer is not free overall delivery.
mustAnswer: Origin transfer is free but viewer delivery follows CloudFront pricing
Applicable edge rates may be lower; all downloads are not free

cards.topic: Aurora idle pausing / Aurora空闲暂停
cards.learningGoal: 开发PostgreSQL数据库长时间没人连接，可接受恢复时短暂等待。使用支持自动暂停的Aurora Serverless版本时，怎样减少空闲算力费用？
cards.frontZh: 开发PostgreSQL数据库长时间没人连接，可接受恢复时短暂等待。使用支持自动暂停的Aurora Serverless版本时，怎样减少空闲算力费用？
cards.frontEn: A development PostgreSQL DB is idle for long periods and can tolerate a short resume wait. On an Aurora Serverless version supporting pause, how can idle compute cost fall?
cards.answerZh: 启用自动暂停，把支持的最小容量设为0 ACU，并设定空闲等待时间。
cards.answerEn: Enable automatic pause, set a supported minimum of zero ACUs, and configure the idle wait.
cards.keyPointZh: 没有用户连接一段时间后实例可暂停，下一次连接触发恢复；只是选了Serverless名称，并不等于默认就会降到零或立刻响应。
cards.keyPointEn: After no user connections for a period, the instance pauses; the next connection triggers resume. Serverless naming alone does not mean zero capacity by default or instant responses.
mustAnswer: Automatic pause with supported zero-ACU minimum and idle interval
Idle pause removes running compute until a connection resumes it

cards.topic: S3 Bucket Key request charges / S3 Bucket Key请求费
cards.learningGoal: S3对象使用SSE-KMS，新增对象持续写入且读取频繁。必须继续使用KMS加密，怎样减少KMS请求费用，为什么？
cards.frontZh: S3对象使用SSE-KMS，新增对象持续写入且读取频繁。必须继续使用KMS加密，怎样减少KMS请求费用，为什么？
cards.frontEn: S3 objects use SSE-KMS with continuing new writes and frequent reads. KMS encryption must stay. How can KMS request costs fall, and why?
cards.answerZh: 为新增对象启用S3 Bucket Key（桶密钥）。
cards.answerEn: Enable S3 Bucket Key for new objects.
cards.keyPointZh: S3临时保留从KMS取得的桶级密钥，用它生成对象数据密钥，减少逐对象访问KMS的请求。
cards.keyPointEn: S3 temporarily retains a KMS-derived bucket-level key to generate object data keys, reducing per-object KMS requests.
cards.watchOutZh: 这会减少而非消除KMS调用；已有对象不会因开启桶设置就自动使用Bucket Key。
cards.watchOutEn: This reduces rather than eliminates KMS calls. Existing objects do not automatically adopt Bucket Keys when the bucket setting changes.
mustAnswer: Enable S3 Bucket Key for new objects
Bucket-level key reuse reduces per-object KMS requests

cards.topic: Aurora headless DR secondaries / Aurora无实例灾备副本
cards.learningGoal: Aurora global database灾备Region暂不提供查询，希望保留复制数据却少付常驻数据库计算费。支持的headless secondary怎样取舍？
cards.frontZh: Aurora global database灾备Region暂不提供查询，希望保留复制数据却少付常驻数据库计算费。支持的headless secondary怎样取舍？
cards.frontEn: An Aurora global database DR Region serves no queries. How does a supported headless secondary retain replication while reducing resident compute cost?
cards.answerZh: 可以保留支持的无DB实例secondary存储，灾后需要时再补相应计算。
cards.answerEn: Retain supported secondary storage without DB instances, adding compute when recovery needs it.
cards.keyPointZh: Aurora复制存储与运行数据库计算可以分开，平时不运行secondary实例可减少计算费，但恢复时需要启动计算。
cards.keyPointEn: Replicated storage and database compute can be separate. No resident secondary instances means lower compute cost but later compute startup.
cards.watchOutZh: 须为相应引擎和版本支持的部署；存储仍收费，也不等于具备立即可用的查询或接管实例。
cards.watchOutEn: Engine/version support applies. Storage still costs money and no immediately usable query/failover instance is provided.
mustAnswer: Supported instance-free secondary storage
Saves resident compute but needs compute added for recovery

cards.topic: EFS cold-file tiering / EFS冷文件分层
cards.learningGoal: 共享POSIX文件长期少读，但应用仍要沿用同一文件路径。怎样减少EFS存储费用，而不是改成取对象的应用？
cards.frontZh: 共享POSIX文件长期少读，但应用仍要沿用同一文件路径。怎样减少EFS存储费用，而不是改成取对象的应用？
cards.frontEn: Shared POSIX files are rarely read but must retain the same file paths. How can EFS cost fall without changing applications to object access?
cards.answerZh: 评估EFS生命周期管理，把符合条件的冷文件转入较低成本的EFS访问层。
cards.answerEn: Evaluate EFS lifecycle management to move eligible cold files into lower-cost access tiers.
cards.keyPointZh: 分层在文件系统内发生，应用继续通过文件接口访问，存储费用与冷文件访问费用之间产生取舍。
cards.keyPointEn: Tiering occurs inside the filesystem, preserving file interfaces while trading storage charges against cold-file access charges.
cards.watchOutZh: 不是只看每GiB单价；访问量和所选层适用条件也影响总费用。
cards.watchOutEn: Per-GiB pricing alone is insufficient; access volume and tier eligibility affect total cost.
mustAnswer: EFS lifecycle tiering
Preserves file paths/interfaces while moving eligible cold files

cards.topic: DynamoDB table-class costs / DynamoDB表类费用
cards.learningGoal: DynamoDB读写频繁，与大量数据很少读写、主要付存储费，这两种负载的Standard和Standard-IA表类怎样取舍？
cards.frontZh: DynamoDB读写频繁，与大量数据很少读写、主要付存储费，这两种负载的Standard和Standard-IA表类怎样取舍？
cards.frontEn: How do Standard and Standard-IA compare for frequent DynamoDB requests versus large rarely accessed datasets dominated by storage cost?
cards.answerZh: 频繁请求通常比较Standard；存储费用占主导且访问稀少时比较Standard-IA总费用。
cards.answerEn: Usually compare Standard for frequent requests and Standard-IA total cost for storage-heavy rare access.
cards.keyPointZh: Standard-IA降低适用存储单价，同时有不同请求计价，须按存储量与请求量共同计算。
cards.keyPointEn: Standard-IA lowers eligible storage rates with different request pricing. Calculate storage and request volume together.
cards.watchOutZh: 表类与on-demand/provisioned容量模式是独立选择；预留预置容量折扣只适用于单Region的Standard，Standard-IA不适用。
cards.watchOutEn: Table class is independent of on-demand/provisioned mode. Reserved provisioned-capacity discounts apply only to single-Region Standard, not Standard-IA.
mustAnswer: Frequent requests: compare Standard; storage-dominated rare access: Standard-IA
Compare both storage and request prices

cards.topic: Burst credits and charges / 突发积分与费用
cards.learningGoal: EC2平时CPU基线很低，偶尔显著突发。T类burstable实例的credit和unlimited怎样影响选择？
cards.frontZh: EC2平时CPU基线很低，偶尔显著突发。T类burstable实例的credit和unlimited怎样影响选择？
cards.frontEn: EC2 has low baseline CPU with occasional strong bursts. How do burstable T-instance credits and Unlimited affect selection?
cards.answerZh: 评估突发频率和时长：credit允许在基线以上突发，unlimited可在相应条件下继续突发，但可能收取额外费用。
cards.answerEn: Assess burst frequency/duration. Credits permit above-baseline bursts; Unlimited can continue under applicable conditions but may add charges.
cards.keyPointZh: 低平均负载可利用积累积分，长期高CPU会改变性能和费用结果，不应只看实例基础单价。
cards.keyPointEn: Low average workloads use accumulated credits. Sustained high CPU changes performance and cost, so base instance price alone is insufficient.
cards.watchOutZh: 若CPU长期高，应比较持续计算规格；unlimited不等于免费无限CPU。
cards.watchOutEn: For long high-CPU periods compare sustained-compute types. Unlimited is not free unlimited CPU.
mustAnswer: Evaluate credit use and burst duration
Unlimited may extend bursts with additional charges

cards.topic: ONTAP hot/cold tiering / ONTAP冷热分层
cards.learningGoal: ONTAP文件中只有少量经常访问，其余长期很冷。怎样减少昂贵SSD容量，又保留热点低延迟？
cards.frontZh: ONTAP文件中只有少量经常访问，其余长期很冷。怎样减少昂贵SSD容量，又保留热点低延迟？
cards.frontEn: Few ONTAP files are active and most are cold. How can expensive SSD capacity fall while preserving hot-data latency?
cards.answerZh: 使用ONTAP数据分层，把冷数据转入较低成本的容量层。
cards.answerEn: Use ONTAP data tiering to move cold data into its lower-cost capacity tier.
cards.keyPointZh: 性能层的SSD承担活跃数据访问，容量层接纳低频数据，减少为了全部历史数据购买SSD。
cards.keyPointEn: Performance-tier SSD serves active data while capacity storage holds infrequent data, avoiding SSD purchases for all history.
cards.watchOutZh: 从容量层取回冷数据有不同的性能和访问费用，不能要求所有冷数据始终具有SSD热读体验。
cards.watchOutEn: Cold retrieval has different performance/access charges; not every cold read retains SSD-hot latency.
mustAnswer: Tier cold data to the capacity tier
Keep active data on SSD rather than all history

cards.topic: EBS archive billing size / EBS归档计费大小
cards.learningGoal: EBS旧快照长期不读，归档每GiB便宜，就一定比标准层省钱吗？
cards.frontZh: EBS旧快照长期不读，归档每GiB便宜，就一定比标准层省钱吗？
cards.frontEn: Old unread EBS snapshots have a lower archive per-GiB price. Is archive necessarily cheaper?
cards.answerZh: 不一定，要按归档后的完整快照大小及保留、恢复费用比较。
cards.answerEn: No. Compare full archived-snapshot size with retention and restoration charges.
cards.keyPointZh: 标准层快照利用增量块共享；归档时会转成包含该恢复点全部已写数据块的完整快照，计费数据量可能变大。
cards.keyPointEn: Standard snapshots share incremental blocks. Archiving produces a full snapshot of all written blocks at that recovery point, potentially increasing billed size.
cards.watchOutZh: 归档快照须先恢复才能用于创建卷，不能只比较存储单价。
cards.watchOutEn: Archive must be restored before creating volumes; storage unit rates alone are insufficient.
mustAnswer: Compare full archive size and retention/restore costs
Incremental sharing does not preserve the same billed size in archive

cards.topic: Costs of many small objects / 海量小对象费用
cards.learningGoal: 有海量小文件，很少读取。只看归档层每GiB单价，就能选出最便宜的S3存储层吗？
cards.frontZh: 有海量小文件，很少读取。只看归档层每GiB单价，就能选出最便宜的S3存储层吗？
cards.frontEn: Can archive per-GiB rates alone identify the cheapest S3 class for many rarely read tiny files?
cards.answerZh: 不能；还要计算最小计费对象大小、每次转换请求和适用的元数据开销。
cards.answerEn: No. Include minimum billable object size, transition requests, and applicable metadata overhead.
cards.keyPointZh: 单文件很小时，按对象收取的费用和最低计费单位可能超过实际数据存储费用；较低的GiB单价不一定降低总账单。
cards.keyPointEn: For tiny files, per-object charges and minimum billing units can outweigh actual bytes. A lower GiB rate need not lower the total bill.
cards.watchOutZh: 还须满足最短保留时间及取回要求，不能把不满足访问条件的层拿来比价。
cards.watchOutEn: Minimum retention and retrieval requirements still apply; unsuitable access tiers are not valid comparisons.
mustAnswer: Include object minima, transition requests, and metadata overhead
Per-object costs can dominate tiny-file storage

cards.topic: Automatic S3 instant tiering / S3自动即时分层
cards.learningGoal: S3对象冷热难预测，用户仍需立即读取。怎样减少手工判断每个对象应放哪一层？
cards.frontZh: S3对象冷热难预测，用户仍需立即读取。怎样减少手工判断每个对象应放哪一层？
cards.frontEn: S3 access patterns are unpredictable and reads must remain immediate. How can per-object manual tier decisions be reduced?
cards.answerZh: 使用S3 Intelligent-Tiering，让它按访问情况调整适用的即时访问层。
cards.answerEn: Use S3 Intelligent-Tiering to adjust applicable instant-access tiers from observed access.
cards.keyPointZh: 它跟踪访问模式，把不活跃对象转到更低成本的访问层；这些即时访问层跨至少三个AZ保存数据，不必为省钱退回单AZ。
cards.keyPointEn: It tracks patterns and moves inactive objects to cheaper tiers. These instant tiers retain data across at least three AZs without switching to single-AZ storage.
cards.watchOutZh: 它有按对象的监控费用；冷热分界已知时可直接用Lifecycle，不能无条件断言自动分层更便宜。可选异步归档层还需要恢复等待。
cards.watchOutEn: Per-object monitoring costs apply. Known patterns can use Lifecycle directly; optional asynchronous archive tiers require restores, and automatic tiering is not always cheaper.
mustAnswer: Intelligent-Tiering's applicable instant tiers
Observed access drives automatic moves while retaining immediate access

cards.topic: Noncurrent version cleanup / 非当前版本清理
cards.learningGoal: S3桶启用了版本控制，已设置当前对象过期，账单却仍不断增长。还应检查什么生命周期规则？
cards.frontZh: S3桶启用了版本控制，已设置当前对象过期，账单却仍不断增长。还应检查什么生命周期规则？
cards.frontEn: A versioned S3 bucket expires current objects but its bill keeps growing. Which lifecycle rules need checking?
cards.answerZh: 检查并设置非当前版本的过期或转层规则。
cards.answerEn: Configure/check expiration or transitions for noncurrent versions.
cards.keyPointZh: 新上传会让旧版本变成非当前版本；只处理当前版本，不会自动清理这些仍占空间的历史版本。
cards.keyPointEn: New uploads make old versions noncurrent. Current-version rules do not automatically remove that stored history.
cards.watchOutZh: 只保留最新两版时，是当前版加一个非当前版；非当前保留计数不含当前版，还要同时满足年龄等条件后才异步过期。
cards.watchOutEn: Keeping the newest two means current plus one noncurrent. Noncurrent counts exclude current, and age/other conditions must also hold before asynchronous expiry.
mustAnswer: Noncurrent version expiry/transitions
Current-object expiry does not clean all retained history

cards.topic: Incomplete multipart cleanup / 未完成分块清理
cards.learningGoal: S3可见对象数量没增加，但大量分块上传失败后存储费增长。应清理什么，怎样避免反复发生？
cards.frontZh: S3可见对象数量没增加，但大量分块上传失败后存储费增长。应清理什么，怎样避免反复发生？
cards.frontEn: Visible S3 object count is unchanged, but failed multipart uploads increase storage charges. What should be cleaned and how prevented?
cards.answerZh: 清理未完成multipart upload的分块，并配置AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload生命周期规则。
cards.answerEn: Clean unfinished-upload parts and configure AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload lifecycle rules.
cards.keyPointZh: 已上传但尚未合成对象的part仍占空间，不能只靠对象列表或当前对象过期规则处理。
cards.keyPointEn: Uploaded unassembled parts consume storage and are not handled just by object listings or current-object expiration.
cards.watchOutZh: 中止未完成上传，不等于删除已经完成的对象。
cards.watchOutEn: Aborting incomplete uploads does not delete completed objects.
mustAnswer: Remove unfinished multipart parts
AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload rule automates cleanup

cards.topic: Requester Pays / 请求者付费
cards.learningGoal: 公司向外部合作方开放S3数据读取，希望由对方承担读取请求和下载传输费用。怎样改变费用承担方？
cards.frontZh: 公司向外部合作方开放S3数据读取，希望由对方承担读取请求和下载传输费用。怎样改变费用承担方？
cards.frontEn: External partners read S3 data and should pay read requests/download transfer. How can charge responsibility change?
cards.answerZh: 对适用桶启用Requester Pays，并让请求者按要求确认付费。
cards.answerEn: Enable Requester Pays on eligible buckets and have requesters acknowledge payment as required.
cards.keyPointZh: 它把适用的请求和数据传输费用交给请求者，桶所有者仍承担存储费用。
cards.keyPointEn: Applicable request/transfer charges shift to requesters; bucket owners retain storage charges.
cards.watchOutZh: 这改变谁付款，不会自动降低总费用，也不是授予读取权限。
cards.watchOutEn: This changes the payer, not necessarily total cost, and does not grant read access.
mustAnswer: Requester Pays with requester acknowledgment
Transfers eligible request/transfer charges, not storage charges

cards.topic: DynamoDB capacity modes / DynamoDB容量模式
cards.learningGoal: DynamoDB流量难预测，不想预先估计读写容量；与长期稳定且能规划容量的业务，容量模式怎样选？
cards.frontZh: DynamoDB流量难预测，不想预先估计读写容量；与长期稳定且能规划容量的业务，容量模式怎样选？
cards.frontEn: How do DynamoDB capacity modes differ for unpredictable traffic without capacity estimates versus long-term stable plannable usage?
cards.answerZh: 难预测的负载考虑on-demand；稳定且可规划时比较provisioned配合自动伸缩。
cards.answerEn: Consider on-demand for unpredictable load; compare provisioned with autoscaling for stable plannable workloads.
cards.keyPointZh: 按需模式无需预配具体RCU／WCU；预置模式显式配置读写容量并可自动伸缩，稳定利用时可比较其费用优势。
cards.keyPointEn: On-demand avoids preset RCU/WCU quantities. Provisioned sets read/write capacity explicitly and can autoscale, with potential cost benefits under stable utilization.
cards.watchOutZh: 按需不代表任意瞬时峰值都无限承接；仍须核对配额和扩展特性。
cards.watchOutEn: On-demand is not unlimited instantaneous peaks; check quotas and scaling characteristics.
mustAnswer: Unpredictable: on-demand
Plannable stable: compare provisioned/autoscaling

cards.topic: Separating analytics and live reads / 分析与在线读取隔离
cards.learningGoal: 要分析DynamoDB历史数据，又不能用大量Scan挤占线上表读取能力。可怎样把分析与在线读取分开？
cards.frontZh: 要分析DynamoDB历史数据，又不能用大量Scan挤占线上表读取能力。可怎样把分析与在线读取分开？
cards.frontEn: DynamoDB history needs analysis without large Scans consuming production read capacity. How can workloads separate?
cards.answerZh: 在支持条件下把表数据导出S3，再对导出数据分析。
cards.answerEn: Export table data to S3 under supported conditions and analyze the export.
cards.keyPointZh: 受支持的数据导出不靠扫描消耗表的读取容量，分析在另一个数据副本上进行。
cards.keyPointEn: Supported export avoids scanning table read capacity. Analytics operates on another data copy.
cards.watchOutZh: 导出有时间点、格式及PITR等适用条件，不代表分析副本持续实时等于在线表。
cards.watchOutEn: Point-in-time, format, and PITR conditions apply; exports do not continuously match live data in real time.
mustAnswer: Supported DynamoDB export to S3
Analyze a separate copy without Scan read-capacity consumption

cards.topic: Long-idle RDS / RDS长期闲置
cards.learningGoal: 开发RDS库要闲置好几周。停止实例后就能一直保持停止、不再产生计算费吗？
cards.frontZh: 开发RDS库要闲置好几周。停止实例后就能一直保持停止、不再产生计算费吗？
cards.frontEn: A development RDS database will be idle for weeks. Can stopping keep it stopped indefinitely without compute charges?
cards.answerZh: 不能；适用RDS实例停止一段受限时间后会自动启动，长期不用可评估保留快照后删除，再按需恢复。
cards.answerEn: No. Eligible stopped instances automatically restart after a limited period. For long inactivity, evaluate snapshot retention followed by deletion and on-demand restore.
cards.keyPointZh: 临时停止适合短期空闲；长期删除计算资源可避免自动重启，但恢复要时间且存储备份仍收费。
cards.keyPointEn: Stopping suits short gaps. Removing compute avoids automatic restart, but recovery takes time and backup storage still costs money.
cards.watchOutZh: 须先确认引擎、拓扑支持停止及快照恢复，并能接受恢复后的连接调整。
cards.watchOutEn: Verify engine/topology stop/restore support and acceptable postrestore connection changes.
mustAnswer: No; a stopped eligible RDS instance automatically restarts after a limited period

cards.topic: RDS commitment discounts / RDS承诺折扣
cards.learningGoal: 一个RDS数据库长期稳定运行。若只比较RDS Reserved DB Instances和Compute Savings Plans，哪种承诺可抵扣它的数据库实例费用？
cards.frontZh: 一个RDS数据库长期稳定运行。若只比较RDS Reserved DB Instances和Compute Savings Plans，哪种承诺可抵扣它的数据库实例费用？
cards.frontEn: A stable RDS database compares only Reserved DB Instances with Compute Savings Plans. Which discounts its instance charges?
cards.answerZh: 符合购买属性的RDS Reserved DB Instances。
cards.answerEn: RDS Reserved DB Instances matching purchase attributes.
cards.keyPointZh: RDS预留折扣面向适用数据库实例；Compute Savings Plans的计算服务范围不包含RDS实例费用。
cards.keyPointEn: RDS reservations cover eligible database instances; Compute Savings Plans exclude RDS instance charges.
cards.watchOutZh: 购买承诺前核对引擎、Region和部署等匹配条件；预留折扣不等于存储和I/O免费。
cards.watchOutEn: Check engine, Region, deployment, and other match conditions. Reservation discounts do not make storage/I/O free.
mustAnswer: Matching RDS Reserved DB Instances
Compute Savings Plans do not cover RDS instance fees

cards.topic: Aurora copy-on-write clones / Aurora写时复制克隆
cards.learningGoal: 开发测试要快速得到一份大型Aurora数据库数据，不想一开始就复制全部底层存储。怎样做？
cards.frontZh: 开发测试要快速得到一份大型Aurora数据库数据，不想一开始就复制全部底层存储。怎样做？
cards.frontEn: Development/testing needs a large Aurora database copy quickly without initially copying all storage. What fits?
cards.answerZh: 使用受支持的Aurora克隆。
cards.answerEn: A supported Aurora clone.
cards.keyPointZh: 克隆采用copy-on-write，起初共享底层数据页，后续发生变化才为相应数据分配存储。
cards.keyPointEn: Copy-on-write initially shares underlying pages and allocates storage for subsequent changes.
cards.watchOutZh: 克隆是用于独立使用的数据库，不是自动跟随生产最新写入的读副本。
cards.watchOutEn: The clone is independently usable, not a read replica automatically following new production writes.
mustAnswer: Aurora clone
Copy-on-write avoids the initial full-storage copy

cards.topic: Aurora I/O pricing tradeoffs / Aurora I/O计费取舍
cards.learningGoal: Aurora账单中存储I/O费用占比很高，而且负载会持续。应只看实例单价，还是比较什么部署计费方式？
cards.frontZh: Aurora账单中存储I/O费用占比很高，而且负载会持续。应只看实例单价，还是比较什么部署计费方式？
cards.frontEn: Aurora storage I/O dominates a sustained bill. Compare only instance prices, or which deployment pricing?
cards.answerZh: 优先比较Aurora I/O-Optimized；I/O请求费占比超过总Aurora费用25%时，是官方建议重点采用的范围。
cards.answerEn: Compare Aurora I/O-Optimized, especially the officially recommended range where I/O requests exceed 25% of total Aurora cost.
cards.keyPointZh: I/O-Optimized不另收适用存储读写I/O请求费，用较高的其他单价换更低总费；例如同等负载下I/O占40%就符合这一判断。Aurora按集群配置比较，不是选择RDS的gp3或io2卷。
cards.keyPointEn: It removes separate eligible storage read/write I/O request charges in exchange for higher other rates. A comparable workload with 40% I/O fits that criterion. Compare cluster configuration, not RDS gp3/io2 volumes.
cards.watchOutZh: 仅流量大不证明总费更低；仍要按计算、存储和I/O合计比较。
cards.watchOutEn: High traffic alone does not prove savings; total compute, storage, and I/O costs matter.
mustAnswer: Compare Aurora I/O-Optimized
Compare total compute, storage, and I/O charges rather than instance price alone

cards.topic: Elastic DMS replication capacity / DMS弹性复制容量
cards.learningGoal: DMS复制负载变化明显，不想一直人工给复制实例选固定规格。有什么受支持的容量方式可比较？
cards.frontZh: DMS复制负载变化明显，不想一直人工给复制实例选固定规格。有什么受支持的容量方式可比较？
cards.frontEn: DMS load varies and continual manual replication-instance sizing is undesirable. Which supported capacity option merits comparison?
cards.answerZh: 评估DMS Serverless，在适用范围和容量上下限内管理复制资源伸缩。
cards.answerEn: DMS Serverless, managing replication scaling within supported scope and capacity bounds.
cards.keyPointZh: 让服务按复制工作量调整所需容量，减少固定复制实例的持续规格管理。
cards.keyPointEn: The service adjusts resources to replication workload, reducing ongoing fixed-instance sizing.
cards.watchOutZh: 先确认源、目标及任务功能受支持；Serverless不是无限容量或不产生费用。
cards.watchOutEn: Check source, target, and task-feature support; serverless is neither unlimited nor free.
mustAnswer: DMS Serverless
Managed workload-based replication capacity within limits

cards.topic: Lower-bandwidth dedicated access / 低带宽专线类型
cards.learningGoal: 机房只需较小带宽的专线，不想按独享物理连接的起始规格购买。可以比较哪种连接方式？
cards.frontZh: 机房只需较小带宽的专线，不想按独享物理连接的起始规格购买。可以比较哪种连接方式？
cards.frontEn: On premises needs modest Direct Connect bandwidth below dedicated physical-connection starting sizes. Which connection types should be compared?
cards.answerZh: 比较Direct Connect合作伙伴提供的hosted connection与dedicated connection。
cards.answerEn: Partner-provided hosted connections versus dedicated connections.
cards.keyPointZh: 例如200 Mbps属于合作伙伴hosted支持的容量；dedicated给客户独享物理连接，不能在控制台把其端口任意切成200 Mbps。
cards.keyPointEn: For example, 200 Mbps is a supported hosted capacity. Dedicated supplies an exclusive physical connection, not an arbitrarily selectable 200-Mbps console slice.
cards.watchOutZh: 支持的容量和功能按连接类型核对，不能把hosted理解为自行把任意dedicated端口切小。
cards.watchOutEn: Check capacity/features by connection type; hosted does not mean manually subdividing any dedicated port.
mustAnswer: Partner-hosted connection compared with dedicated
Hosted supports smaller capacities such as 200 Mbps

cards.topic: Compute near data / 计算靠近数据
cards.learningGoal: 应用与数据跨AZ或Region传输需要付费，原始数据很大、处理结果很小。在满足可用性要求前提下，怎样减少传输？
cards.frontZh: 应用与数据跨AZ或Region传输需要付费，原始数据很大、处理结果很小。在满足可用性要求前提下，怎样减少传输？
cards.frontEn: Large source data produces small results and cross-AZ/Region transfer costs apply. Subject to availability needs, how can transfer fall?
cards.answerZh: 优先让计算靠近大数据所在位置，只把较小结果传往需要的地方。
cards.answerEn: Prefer computation near the large dataset, sending only small results where needed.
cards.keyPointZh: 费用取决于传输量乘路径单价。先让计算靠近大数据、只传小结果；在已有Direct Connect且适用同Region出站计费时，还可利用专线通常较低的出站单价降低这部分费用。
cards.keyPointEn: Cost is volume times path rate. Co-location reduces bytes moved. Where Direct Connect already exists and applicable same-Region egress pricing applies, its typically lower outbound rate can reduce that portion too.
cards.watchOutZh: 按实际Region/接入点和计费档比较；已有专线不代表新增专线的端口费可忽略，也不能为省传输破坏故障隔离。
cards.watchOutEn: Compare actual Regions/access points/tiers. New port costs are not ignorable, and savings must not undermine failure isolation.
mustAnswer: Compute near large source data
Transfer smaller results instead of the raw dataset

cards.topic: EMR Spot node responsibilities / EMR Spot节点职责
cards.learningGoal: EMR要用Spot降费，但控制节点和承载关键HDFS数据的节点不希望被中断。优先把Spot放在哪类节点？
cards.frontZh: EMR要用Spot降费，但控制节点和承载关键HDFS数据的节点不希望被中断。优先把Spot放在哪类节点？
cards.frontEn: EMR should save with Spot, but control and critical HDFS nodes must avoid interruption. Which nodes should use Spot first?
cards.answerZh: 优先用于不存HDFS数据、可重新执行任务的task节点；关键primary/core按可靠性要求使用稳定容量。
cards.answerEn: Prefer task nodes without HDFS storage whose computations can rerun. Use reliability-appropriate stable capacity for critical primary/core nodes.
cards.keyPointZh: task节点提供计算而不承担同样的数据保存职责，中断后重做计算通常比丢控制或数据节点更易恢复。
cards.keyPointEn: Task nodes supply compute without the same data-retention duty, making interrupted computation easier to recover than lost control/data nodes.
cards.watchOutZh: 若具体架构的数据和恢复能力不同，应重新评估，不把这个部署前提推广成所有EMR唯一买法。
cards.watchOutEn: Reevaluate different data/recovery architectures; this premise does not dictate one purchase model for every EMR cluster.
mustAnswer: Spot first on retryable task nodes
Task compute is more recoverable than critical control/HDFS duties

cards.topic: Lambda memory and total cost / Lambda内存与总费
cards.learningGoal: Lambda是CPU密集型任务。减少内存配置就一定降低单次运行费用吗？
cards.frontZh: Lambda是CPU密集型任务。减少内存配置就一定降低单次运行费用吗？
cards.frontEn: A Lambda is CPU-bound. Does lowering memory always reduce per-run cost?
cards.answerZh: 不一定；内存配置也影响分配的CPU资源，应比较配置变化后的运行时长和总费用。
cards.answerEn: No. Memory also affects CPU allocation; compare resulting duration and total cost for each configuration.
cards.keyPointZh: 较少资源可能让任务运行更久，较高资源也可能更快完成；费用取决于资源与持续时间的共同结果。
cards.keyPointEn: Fewer resources can run longer and more resources can finish faster. Cost combines resource allocation and duration.
cards.watchOutZh: 应实测真实负载，不能把“加内存必定更便宜”当通用结论。
cards.watchOutEn: Measure real workloads; increasing memory is not universally cheaper either.
mustAnswer: Compare resource allocation and measured duration
Memory changes CPU and runtime as well as the rate

cards.topic: Interruptible Spot work / Spot可中断任务
cards.learningGoal: 有可重试的批任务，也有不能因Spot回收而中断的服务基线。Spot降费应该优先承载哪一部分？
cards.frontZh: 有可重试的批任务，也有不能因Spot回收而中断的服务基线。Spot降费应该优先承载哪一部分？
cards.frontEn: Some batch work retries, while service baseline cannot tolerate Spot reclamation. Which should use Spot first?
cards.answerZh: 优先承载能容忍中断并恢复的任务，关键基线使用符合可靠性要求的稳定容量。
cards.answerEn: Interruption-tolerant recoverable tasks, with reliability-appropriate stable capacity for critical baseline.
cards.keyPointZh: Spot价格优惠伴随容量被回收的风险，是否能重做或续跑决定适用性，不能只看工作负载运行多久。
cards.keyPointEn: Spot discounts come with reclamation risk. Ability to rerun/resume matters, not simply workload duration.
cards.watchOutZh: 可恢复任务仍要做好检查点、幂等或重试；其他购买方式也不等于应用永远不会故障。
cards.watchOutEn: Recoverable tasks still need checkpoints/idempotency/retries. Other purchase options do not eliminate all application failures.
mustAnswer: Recoverable interruption-tolerant tasks
Keep interruption-sensitive baseline on suitable stable capacity

cards.topic: Price discounts and capacity / 价格折扣与容量
cards.learningGoal: 短期必须在指定AZ有EC2算力。Compute Savings Plans或Regional RI的价格折扣，能保证所需容量吗？
cards.frontZh: 短期必须在指定AZ有EC2算力。Compute Savings Plans或Regional RI的价格折扣，能保证所需容量吗？
cards.frontEn: EC2 capacity in a specified AZ is mandatory short term. Do Compute Savings Plans or Regional RI discounts guarantee it?
cards.answerZh: 不能据此保证；应评估适用的On-Demand Capacity Reservation等容量预留。
cards.answerEn: No. Evaluate applicable On-Demand Capacity Reservations or other capacity reservations.
cards.keyPointZh: 折扣承诺管理价格，容量预留管理相应AZ可用实例容量，目标不同。
cards.keyPointEn: Discount commitments manage price; capacity reservations manage corresponding instance availability in an AZ.
cards.watchOutZh: 某些zonal RI也含容量权益，须按具体产品判断，不能说所有RI都没有容量保证。
cards.watchOutEn: Some zonal RIs include capacity benefits; do not claim every RI lacks a capacity guarantee.
mustAnswer: Applicable AZ capacity reservation
Price discounts alone do not guarantee the required capacity

cards.topic: Physical-host licensing / 物理主机许可证
cards.learningGoal: 软件许可证按物理socket或core计量，还需可见并控制承载物理主机。普通Dedicated Instance就等价于Dedicated Host吗？
cards.frontZh: 软件许可证按物理socket或core计量，还需可见并控制承载物理主机。普通Dedicated Instance就等价于Dedicated Host吗？
cards.frontEn: Licenses count physical sockets/cores and require host visibility/control. Is Dedicated Instance equivalent to Dedicated Host?
cards.answerZh: 不等价；应评估满足授权条件的Dedicated Host。
cards.answerEn: No. Evaluate a Dedicated Host meeting the license conditions.
cards.keyPointZh: Host提供专用物理服务器及相关放置、主机信息控制，适合某些按物理主机计量的BYOL要求。
cards.keyPointEn: Hosts provide dedicated physical servers with placement/host-information control suited to some physical-host BYOL licensing.
cards.watchOutZh: 专用实例不自动提供同等主机控制，实际许可证是否允许迁入还要匹配授权条款。
cards.watchOutEn: Dedicated instances do not automatically provide equivalent control; license terms still must permit migration.
mustAnswer: Suitable Dedicated Host
Physical-server visibility/control differs from Dedicated Instance

cards.topic: No traffic versus released compute / 无流量与释放计算
cards.learningGoal: 非生产应用夜间无人使用。把实例移出负载均衡目标组，就能停止实例计算收费吗？
cards.frontZh: 非生产应用夜间无人使用。把实例移出负载均衡目标组，就能停止实例计算收费吗？
cards.frontEn: Nonproduction is unused overnight. Does deregistering instances from the load balancer stop compute charges?
cards.answerZh: 不能；应按可停条件实际停止、终止或缩减相应计算容量。
cards.answerEn: No. Actually stop, terminate, or reduce eligible compute capacity.
cards.keyPointZh: 没有流量不等于计算资源已释放，费用取决于资源是否仍处于计费运行状态。
cards.keyPointEn: No traffic does not release compute; charges depend on its continuing billable running state.
cards.watchOutZh: 停止计算后存储等资源仍可能收费，恢复要求和依赖也须满足。
cards.watchOutEn: Storage can still charge after stopping; satisfy recovery needs and dependencies.
mustAnswer: Actually stop/terminate/scale down eligible compute
Load-balancer deregistration does not end running-resource billing

cards.topic: Rightsizing recommendations / 规格优化建议
cards.learningGoal: 想为EC2、EC2 Auto Scaling组、ECS的Fargate服务等受支持资源取得具体规格建议，只看监控图够吗？
cards.frontZh: 想为EC2、EC2 Auto Scaling组、ECS的Fargate服务等受支持资源取得具体规格建议，只看监控图够吗？
cards.frontEn: Supported EC2, ASGs, and ECS Fargate services need concrete sizing recommendations. Are monitoring charts alone enough?
cards.answerZh: 评估AWS Compute Optimizer的适用资源建议。
cards.answerEn: Evaluate applicable AWS Compute Optimizer recommendations.
cards.keyPointZh: 监控提供利用率数据；Compute Optimizer分析EC2、EC2 Auto Scaling组、EBS、Lambda及适用ECS Fargate服务等资源，给出规格/配置建议，EBS建议还可列预计月度节省。
cards.keyPointEn: Monitoring supplies utilization. Compute Optimizer analyzes supported EC2/ASGs/EBS/Lambda/ECS Fargate resources for sizing/configuration; EBS recommendations can include estimated monthly savings.
cards.watchOutZh: 建议必须有足够数据且资源受支持，不能将任意AWS资源都视作已纳入建议范围。
cards.watchOutEn: Enough data and supported resource types are required; not every AWS resource is covered.
mustAnswer: Compute Optimizer
Analyzes supported utilization into concrete sizing/configuration advice

cards.topic: Cost anomalies and budgets / 费用异常与预算
cards.learningGoal: 费用明显偏离平时模式，与费用达到明确月预算阈值，应该用同一种告警规则吗？
cards.frontZh: 费用明显偏离平时模式，与费用达到明确月预算阈值，应该用同一种告警规则吗？
cards.frontEn: Should abnormal spending patterns and a fixed monthly budget threshold use the same alert rule?
cards.answerZh: 异常偏离评估Cost Anomaly Detection；明确预算阈值使用AWS Budgets。
cards.answerEn: Evaluate Cost Anomaly Detection for unusual deviation and AWS Budgets for defined thresholds.
cards.keyPointZh: 一个比较正常消费模式，一个比较预先设定的金额或用量目标，触发依据不同。
cards.keyPointEn: One compares normal spending patterns; the other compares preset money/usage targets.
cards.watchOutZh: 收到告警不等于资源已停止，自动限制操作还需另外配置受支持动作。
cards.watchOutEn: Alerts do not stop resources; automatic restrictions require separately configured supported actions.
mustAnswer: Pattern deviation: Cost Anomaly Detection
Explicit threshold: Budgets

cards.topic: Cost views and line items / 费用视图与明细
cards.learningGoal: 要交互分析历史费用或预测，与要逐行分析原始账单明细，Cost Explorer和CUR怎样分工？
cards.frontZh: 要交互分析历史费用或预测，与要逐行分析原始账单明细，Cost Explorer和CUR怎样分工？
cards.frontEn: How do Cost Explorer and CUR differ for interactive historical/forecast analysis versus raw billing-line analysis?
cards.answerZh: 交互分析及适用API查询用Cost Explorer；原始细粒度账单分析用CUR或相应账单数据导出。
cards.answerEn: Use Cost Explorer views/applicable APIs for interactive analysis; use CUR or appropriate billing data exports for fine-grained raw analysis.
cards.keyPointZh: Cost Explorer提供现成视图和适用API，并可按月预测未来12个月；CUR交付细粒度明细，供自定义查询和分析。
cards.keyPointEn: Cost Explorer provides ready views/APIs and monthly forecasts up to 12 future months. CUR supplies detailed records for custom querying.
cards.watchOutZh: 组织合并账单须有相应账户权限与交付范围，成员账户可见数据不自动等于全组织完整账单。
cards.watchOutEn: Consolidated-billing analysis needs appropriate account permissions/delivery scope; member visibility is not automatically complete organization billing.
mustAnswer: Interactive/forecast: Cost Explorer
Raw fine-grained records: CUR or appropriate export

cards.topic: Activating cost-allocation tags / 激活成本分配标签
cards.learningGoal: 在组织集中计费下，资源已打业务部门标签，却不能据此正常分摊账单。还要由谁在费用管理侧做什么？
cards.frontZh: 在组织集中计费下，资源已打业务部门标签，却不能据此正常分摊账单。还要由谁在费用管理侧做什么？
cards.frontEn: Under consolidated billing, resources have department tags but bills cannot be allocated accordingly. Who must do what in cost management?
cards.answerZh: 由组织管理账户在Billing激活相应cost allocation tag，再在Cost Explorer等费用视图按实际可用的该标签维度分组分析。
cards.answerEn: The management account activates the cost allocation tag in Billing, then groups available cost views such as Cost Explorer by that tag.
cards.keyPointZh: 资源标签用于标识资源，激活的成本分配标签才进入账单分析维度；如已正确记录Owner用户的资源归属，可按Owner标签汇总，不能把IAM用户身份自动当所有服务的账单维度。
cards.keyPointEn: Resource tags identify resources; activation adds billing dimensions. Correctly recorded Owner tags can aggregate ownership, but IAM users are not automatically universal billing dimensions.
cards.watchOutZh: 历史费用是否能补齐取决于支持的回填和历史标签条件，不是今天加标签就保证全部旧账单已有正确归属。
cards.watchOutEn: Historical allocation depends on supported backfill and historic tags; adding a tag today does not guarantee old bills are correctly attributed.
mustAnswer: Management account activates the tag in Billing
Then analyze by the available cost-allocation tag dimension

cards.topic: Utilization and coverage budgets / 利用率与覆盖率预算
cards.learningGoal: 已购Savings Plans承诺闲置，与用量没被折扣覆盖，需要哪种预算指标来分别监控并自动通知？
cards.frontZh: 已购Savings Plans承诺闲置，与用量没被折扣覆盖，需要哪种预算指标来分别监控并自动通知？
cards.frontEn: Which budget metrics separately monitor idle Savings Plans commitments and eligible usage lacking discounts, with automatic notification?
cards.answerZh: 承诺闲置看utilization budget；适用用量没被覆盖看coverage budget。在AWS Budgets设置相应阈值及通知。
cards.answerEn: Set utilization budgets for unused commitments and coverage budgets for uncovered usage, with thresholds/notifications in AWS Budgets.
cards.keyPointZh: utilization比较用掉多少已购承诺，coverage比较多少用量已被覆盖；选对分母，预算才能在相应比例低于目标时提醒。
cards.keyPointEn: Utilization measures consumed purchased commitment; coverage measures discounted usage share. Correct denominators trigger alerts below the respective targets.
cards.watchOutZh: 利用率低还加买会扩大闲置；覆盖率低也要先评估未来稳定用量，不等于立即购买。
cards.watchOutEn: Buying more with low utilization expands idle commitments; low coverage still requires assessing future stable usage.
mustAnswer: Idle commitment: utilization budget
Uncovered usage: coverage budget, with thresholds/notifications

cards.topic: Organization optimization permissions / 组织优化建议权限
cards.learningGoal: 组织已合并账单，是否就自动能跨账户查看所有资源的节省建议？
cards.frontZh: 组织已合并账单，是否就自动能跨账户查看所有资源的节省建议？
cards.frontEn: Does consolidated billing automatically allow cross-account access to every resource savings recommendation?
cards.answerZh: 不自动等于能看全部；按优化服务配置组织接入、授权和适用账户范围。
cards.answerEn: No. Configure organization integration, authorization, and applicable account scope in each optimization service.
cards.keyPointZh: 合并账单与建议服务权限不同。例如现行Trusted Advisor的RDS预留购买建议，payer看到付款范围、linked账户看到本账户范围，并须启用其Cost Optimization Hub前提。
cards.keyPointEn: Billing consolidation differs from recommendation permissions. Current Trusted Advisor RDS reservation advice gives payer-wide versus linked-account scope and requires its Cost Optimization Hub prerequisite.
cards.watchOutZh: 不能把一个服务的授权当全部服务通行证，也不能把旧检查的单账户范围当作所有现行检查的限制。
cards.watchOutEn: One service's access is not universal. Historical single-account limits are not restrictions on every current check.
mustAnswer: Configure optimization-service integration and permissions
Consolidated billing alone does not grant all recommendation access

cards.topic: Archive retrieval tiers / 归档取回档位
cards.learningGoal: 归档文件必须在几分钟或一天内取回，只写“用Glacier”就够吗？为什么还要选取回档位？
cards.frontZh: 归档文件必须在几分钟或一天内取回，只写“用Glacier”就够吗？为什么还要选取回档位？
cards.frontEn: Archived files need retrieval within minutes or a day. Is 'Glacier' enough, and why select a retrieval tier?
cards.answerZh: 不够。Flexible Retrieval的Expedited对小于250MB的对象通常1–5分钟，Standard通常3–5小时；Deep Archive的Standard通常12小时，Bulk通常48小时。
cards.answerEn: No. Flexible Retrieval Expedited typically takes 1–5 minutes for objects below 250 MB and Standard 3–5 hours. Deep Archive Standard typically takes 12 hours and Bulk 48 hours.
cards.keyPointZh: 类别与取回档位共同决定等待和费用；例如6小时预算可比较Flexible Standard，没必要只为速度付Expedited费；24小时预算不能选Deep Archive Bulk。
cards.keyPointEn: Class and retrieval tier jointly determine wait/cost. A six-hour budget can compare Flexible Standard without paying for Expedited solely for speed; a 24-hour budget excludes Deep Archive Bulk.
cards.watchOutZh: 通常时长不是硬保证；大对象还受取回吞吐影响，严格分钟级需求要评估预置取回容量及实际对象大小。
cards.watchOutEn: Typical times are not hard guarantees. Large-object throughput matters; strict minute-level needs require evaluating provisioned retrieval capacity and object size.
mustAnswer: Choose both archive class and retrieval tier matching the deadline
Different tiers have distinct wait/cost tradeoffs, not one universal Glacier time

cards.topic: Commitment duration and prepayment / 承诺期限与预付
cards.learningGoal: 稳定用量可持续三年，比较适用EC2/RDS预留、Dedicated Host预留及Compute Savings Plans。只在开机时付承诺费吗，能预付时怎样争取更深折扣？
cards.frontZh: 稳定用量可持续三年，比较适用EC2/RDS预留、Dedicated Host预留及Compute Savings Plans。只在开机时付承诺费吗，能预付时怎样争取更深折扣？
cards.frontEn: Stable usage lasts three years. For eligible EC2/RDS reservations, Dedicated Host reservations, and Compute Savings Plans, are fees owed only while running? How can prepayment deepen discounts?
cards.answerZh: 承诺期内约定费用仍需支付；在这些匹配的选项中，较长期限和更多预付通常换取更深折扣，可比较三年全预付。
cards.answerEn: Committed fees remain due throughout the term. Among matching options, longer terms/more prepayment generally deepen discounts; compare three-year all-upfront.
cards.keyPointZh: 折扣来自交出未来用量和付款灵活性；Dedicated Host也有适用的一年/三年预留。关机或只在部分小时运行，不会自动取消承诺期费用。
cards.keyPointEn: Discounts exchange future usage/payment flexibility. Dedicated Hosts also have applicable one-/three-year reservations. Stopping or part-time use does not cancel committed fees.
cards.watchOutZh: 先核服务、供给和未来利用率；不是每种Savings Plan都有同一期限/支付选项。Scheduled Instances也已不能新购。
cards.watchOutEn: Check service, availability, and utilization; not every Savings Plan has identical terms/payment options. Scheduled Instances cannot be newly purchased.
mustAnswer: Fees remain due for the commitment term
Compare applicable longer terms/more prepayment such as three-year all-upfront

cards.topic: Native RDS cluster PITR / RDS集群原生PITR
cards.learningGoal: RDS PostgreSQL Multi-AZ DB cluster要保留最近30天原生自动备份/PITR。AWS Backup周期快照计划能直接接管这段连续窗口吗？
cards.frontZh: RDS PostgreSQL Multi-AZ DB cluster要保留最近30天原生自动备份/PITR。AWS Backup周期快照计划能直接接管这段连续窗口吗？
cards.frontEn: RDS PostgreSQL Multi-AZ DB clusters need 30 days of native automatic backups/PITR. Can AWS Backup periodic snapshots directly take over that continuous window?
cards.answerZh: 不能；为集群原生自动备份设置30天保留期，其合法范围为1–35天。
cards.answerEn: No. Configure native cluster automatic-backup retention to 30 days, within its 1–35-day range.
cards.keyPointZh: AWS Backup当前不支持这种Multi-AZ DB cluster的连续备份/PITR。周期快照只保留离散恢复点，不能冒充原生自动备份的连续窗口。
cards.keyPointEn: AWS Backup currently does not support continuous backup/PITR for this Multi-AZ DB cluster type. Periodic snapshots retain discrete points, not the native continuous window.
mustAnswer: Native automatic-backup retention of 30 days
AWS Backup periodic snapshots do not replace this continuous PITR window

cards.topic: Minimum storage billing periods / 最低存储计费期
cards.learningGoal: 文件转归档后只再保留60天。到期删除后，就只付实际60天存储费吗？
cards.frontZh: 文件转归档后只再保留60天。到期删除后，就只付实际60天存储费吗？
cards.frontEn: Files stay only 60 days after archival. Does deletion then mean paying just those 60 days?
cards.answerZh: 不一定；若低于该层的最低存储计费期，还要支付剩余天数的存储费。
cards.answerEn: Not necessarily. If below the class's minimum billable duration, remaining storage-duration charges apply.
cards.keyPointZh: 最低计费期从进入该层起算：Standard-IA/One Zone-IA为30天，Glacier Instant/Flexible Retrieval为90天，Deep Archive为180天。Lifecycle删除或再次转层不会免除这笔费用。
cards.keyPointEn: The minimum starts on entry: Standard-IA/One Zone-IA 30 days, Glacier Instant/Flexible Retrieval 90, Deep Archive 180. Lifecycle deletion or another transition does not waive it.
cards.watchOutZh: 最低计费期是费用规则，不是禁止提前删除；还要比较该层单价，不能仅因不足期限就断定它更贵。
cards.watchOutEn: This is billing, not a ban on early deletion. Compare rates too; being under the minimum does not alone prove a tier more expensive.
mustAnswer: Remaining minimum-duration charges can apply
Billing minimum begins when entering the class and survives early deletion/transition

cards.topic: S3 storage-rate ordering / S3存储单价排序
cards.learningGoal: 数据要保存多年、几乎不读取，几个存储层都满足取回等待要求。只按每GB月单价比较，S3各存储层的贵贱顺序是什么，依据什么？
cards.frontZh: 数据要保存多年、几乎不读取，几个存储层都满足取回等待要求。只按每GB月单价比较，S3各存储层的贵贱顺序是什么，依据什么？
cards.frontEn: Data stays years with almost no reads and all candidate tiers meet retrieval waits. What is the approximate descending S3 per-GB-month order, and why?
cards.answerZh: 即时访问层的存储单价高于需等待恢复的归档层，从高到低大致是：S3 Standard、Standard-IA、Glacier Instant Retrieval、Glacier Flexible Retrieval、Glacier Deep Archive；One Zone-IA低于Standard-IA但只存单AZ。现行具体数值以S3定价页为准。
cards.answerEn: Roughly Standard, Standard-IA, Glacier Instant Retrieval, Glacier Flexible Retrieval, then Glacier Deep Archive. One Zone-IA is below Standard-IA but single-AZ. Use current S3 pricing for exact rates.
cards.keyPointZh: 单价用等待换：能接受恢复等待，才进入更低的归档价位。Glacier系列存储层就是为低成本长期存档设计的，代价是最低存储期和取回费。
